method.construction: Start from the mandatory triple on primes 47, 211, and 6073. Repeatedly attach the unselected tile with the least exact gap cost along an available mandatory parent edge, with deterministic order, prime, and parent tie breaks; stop before the first nonpositive gap.
method.proof_rule: A 2-tree begins with one triangle and attaches each new vertex along an existing edge. For every nonempty induced vertex set S, reverse elimination gives |E(S)|-|T(S)| <= |S|-1. Mandatory pair and triple surjectivity make the integrated alternating mass exact.
